title: multiclass-classification-result.v1
description: Project Spec S0210: strict persisted schema for a governed internal multiclass runtime prediction result. Mirrors contracts/execution-contract.schema.json's multiclass_result_semantics plus a deterministic per-prediction argmax decision and ordered class probability distribution. Never defines a positive/negative class, a threshold, a risk interpretation, or a confidence field -- those remain exclusively binary-classification-result.v1 concepts.

class_probabilities.description: The complete, normatively ordered set of governed classes with their resolved probabilities. Array order is normative (governed class order) and must never be persisted sorted by probability.

model_family.description: Bounded to the four Project Spec S0208/S0209 external fitted-model v2 estimator families -- multiclass has no internal Atlas training source.
